verdict.rationale: PostHog's product analytics docs explicitly cover building funnels, drop-off/retention, trends, and other insights with dashboards and alerts (posthog-docs-15, posthog-docs-25), plus SQL/data-warehouse querying for deeper self-serve analysis without an analyst. This is a core, self-service, no-code UI feature aimed at founders/PMs, not just engineers. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on account specifically validating funnel/drop-off usability for a non-technical founder, and no direct evidence addressing ease-of-use claims beyond docs.
